notes.notes:
0.1.3 / 0.1.4 Update 

Fixed an input bug with the "W" key in the tutorial 

Adjusted THE_FOREST in the Dummy Mode, removing forgotten placeholders

Removed the automatic Discord link opened when accepting the EULA, following receieved feedback

notes.title: 0.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
0.1.2 Update

We have made some fixes for certain bugs as well as added some features.

You can find the list of changes below :

GENERAL

 It's now possible to launch Team Deathmatch Gamemap on THE PLANTATION, in custom sessions.


MAPS

 Tutorial update to avoid skipping steps.
 Level layout modifications to break line of sight on spawns (Prevents spawnpeeking).


PROGRAMMATION

 Audio now loads properly on startup, and refreshes the UI accordingly.
 Additional effects upon taking damage.
 Players now invincible for a short duration when they respawn. Should help with spawnkilling / Spawnpeeking.
 Session settings now persist through games.
 Boosted slide was not working after the 1st use, it now works during the whole game.
 Improved spawning algorithm.

notes.title: 0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
0.1.1 Update

We have made some fixes to certain bugs present at the opening of the Playtest.

You can find the list of changes below :

GENERAL

 Deactivation of the SteamVR plugin
 Ability to modify graphical options in-game


MAPS

 You can no longer get stuck in certain containers in AREA7
 You can no longer go behind the fences at the edge of the map in AREA7
 Climbing is now possible on the terrain of THE MINE


PROGRAMMATION

 Fixes applied to "camera" and "aim" sensitivity
 Fixes for being able to pass through certain walls with the climbing mechanic
